# 전자출결점검사항 LMS Attendance Checklist  
## **Access path ‘Attendance’**  
https://eclass.bufs.ac.kr/ > Click on the Course you want to check on the Dashboard > ‘Attendance’  
- If the 'Attendance Status' menu is not visible, please take the following steps:  
How to fix: Click ‘Settings(설정)' at the bottom > Click the [Navigation(내비게이션)] tab > Drag and drop 'Attendance(출결현황)' into the top category.

## Attendance-[View Subsections]  
[View Subsections(차시별출결합산)] refers to :  
① The total value of [View components(학습요소별보기)] ②The reference value used to calculate attendance scores.  
e.g.  
1. [View components] for Week 1, Session 1 consists of 2 parts: ① Attendance marked ● through VOD (weekly learning video) viewing. ② Attendance marked ● through ATN (face-to-face class attendance: smart attendance or manual attendance). ∴ Both ①and ②are attended, resulting in a ● for attendance in the [View Subsections] 2. [View components] for Week 1, Session 3 consists of 2 parts: ① Attending the LIVE (Zoom class) results in a ● for attendance. ② Not watching the VOD (weekly learning video) results in an **X** for absence. ∴ Combining ①and ②, the attendance is marked as partial ( **▲** ) in [View Subsections].  
- **Note:** For the Nth session attendance data in [View components] : - If all entries are present, it will be marked as present (●) in [View  
- Subsections]. - If there is a mix of present and absent entries, it will be marked as  
- partial attendance ( **▲** ) in [View Subsections]. - If all entries are absent, it will be marked as absent ( **X** ) in [View Subsections].

# Attendance[View Subsections]  
To input the final grades, Attendance data for all sessions in the 15th week must be entered in [Attendance – View subsections].  
How to Check and Modify Attendance Data Detailed History You can check it Attendance–[View components]  
Name(No.) Class Date/Time When Modifying Attendance Data Name(No.) You can enter a brief reason for the change in preparation for audits, etc. After modifying the data, be sure to click the apply button. 클릭
